familyPolicy.description: No account required — each traveller submits their own DIPC directly without registration

prerequisites.description: Valid passport with at least 6 months validity beyond your stay
Confirmed flight details including flight number and arrival date
Address or accommodation details in Australia

fields.label: Country of Issue (Passport)
fields.helpText: The country that issued your passport

fields.label: Seat Class
fields.helpText: Select the class of your seat on the aircraft

fields.label: Last Country Visited Before Australia
fields.helpText: The last country you were in before boarding your flight to Australia

fields.label: Street Address
fields.helpText: Street number and name of your accommodation in Australia

fields.label: City / Suburb
fields.helpText: City or suburb of your accommodation

fields.label: Are you carrying food of any kind (fruits, vegetables, meat, fish, eggs, dairy, nuts, seeds)?
fields.helpText: Includes food in your hand luggage or checked baggage, including packaged foods, snacks, and meals

fields.label: Are you carrying plants or plant material (flowers, bulbs, seeds, straw, bamboo, wood)?
fields.helpText: Includes cut flowers, pot plants, timber, bark, cane, bamboo, and similar items

fields.label: Are you carrying animals or animal products (including insects, birds, feathers, fur, bones, shells, horns)?
fields.helpText: Includes live animals, raw or processed animal products, animal medicines, and animal-derived equipment

fields.label: Have you been in contact with farms, bushland, or fresh waterways in the last 30 days?
fields.helpText: Includes hiking, camping, farming, fishing, or visiting national parks. Footwear and outdoor equipment may carry soil or seeds.

fields.label: Are you carrying soil or have had contact with soil or fresh water (including water sports equipment)?
fields.helpText: Includes diving/snorkelling gear, hiking boots with soil residue, freshwater fishing equipment

fields.label: Are you carrying controlled substances, weapons, or restricted goods?
fields.helpText: Includes firearms, prohibited weapons, illicit drugs, steroids, certain medications (in quantities exceeding personal use), and counterfeit goods

fields.label: Are you carrying AUD 10,000 or more in currency (cash, traveller's cheques, money orders, or bearer negotiable instruments)?
fields.helpText: This includes the combined total of all currencies you are carrying. Equivalent amounts in foreign currency must be declared.

fields.label: Are you carrying goods that may be subject to customs duty or tax (new or commercial goods, gifts, samples)?
fields.helpText: Australia has a duty-free allowance. Adults: AUD 900 (includes alcohol and tobacco within limits). Duty-free alcohol: 2.25L per adult aged 18+. Tobacco: 25 cigarettes or 25g of tobacco per adult 18+.

fields.label: Are you carrying commercial goods, samples, or goods intended for sale or business use?
fields.helpText: Includes goods you are importing for sale, business samples, or goods belonging to others

submissionGuide.title: Open the ABF DIPC Portal
submissionGuide.description: Visit online.abf.gov.au and select 'Incoming Passenger Card'. No account or registration is required. You can complete the card from 72 hours before your arrival.
tips: The DIPC replaces the old paper Incoming Passenger Card (IPC)
You can submit from 72 hours before your flight
Have your passport and flight details ready
Save your submission reference number at the end

submissionGuide.title: Enter Personal Details
submissionGuide.description: Fill in your personal information exactly as it appears on your passport, including your family name, given names, date of birth, sex, and country of birth.
tips: Use the same spelling as your passport — no abbreviations
If your passport shows only one name, enter it as your family name

submissionGuide.title: Enter Passport Details
submissionGuide.description: Enter your passport number, expiry date, and the country that issued your passport.
tips: Double-check your passport number carefully
Ensure your passport is valid for at least 6 months beyond your intended stay

submissionGuide.title: Enter Travel Details
submissionGuide.description: Provide your flight number, arrival date, seat class, and the last country you visited before Australia.
tips: Your flight number is on your boarding pass or e-ticket
The last country visited is where your flight to Australia departed from
Transit passengers should select 'In Transit' as the purpose of visit

submissionGuide.title: Enter Australian Address
submissionGuide.description: Provide the address where you will be staying in Australia. Use your first accommodation address if you are visiting multiple places.
tips: If staying in multiple locations, enter the first address
Transit passengers may use the transit area or hotel address
Hotel/hostel names are acceptable as street addresses if the full address is not known

submissionGuide.title: Biosecurity Declarations
submissionGuide.description: Declare whether you are carrying any food, plants, animals, or animal products, or have been in contact with farms or bushland. Australia has strict biosecurity laws — when in doubt, declare it.
tips: Always declare if unsure — ABF officers can inspect and allow permitted items through
Failure to declare biosecurity risk items can result in fines of up to AUD 420 on the spot
Sealed, commercially packaged food is generally permitted but must still be declared
Walking boots with soil residue should be declared — biosecurity officers will clean them

submissionGuide.title: Customs Declarations
submissionGuide.description: Declare any controlled substances, weapons, currency over AUD 10,000, or goods exceeding duty-free allowances.
tips: Declare all currency — this is not a tax, just a reporting requirement
The duty-free allowance for adults is AUD 900 (excluding alcohol and tobacco)
Gifts and souvenirs are included in the duty-free allowance
Declaring goods does not automatically mean you will pay duty

submissionGuide.title: Review and Submit
submissionGuide.description: Review all your answers carefully before submitting. Once submitted you will receive a confirmation with a reference number. Save or screenshot this for your records.
tips: Check all details match your passport exactly
Note your confirmation reference number
No QR code is issued — ABF officers will verify your submission via passport scan at arrival
You may be asked biosecurity or customs questions at the border regardless of your declarations
